description: This source file provides an interface and implementation for an SSH client in Kotlin, utilizing the JSch library. It defines data structures for SSH command execution results, supports executing commands asynchronously with timeout and bounded output capture, and includes both a production-ready implementation and a mock for testing. The file is focused on SSH communication logic, configurations, and safe default practices.

classes.name: SshResult
classes.description: Data class representing the result of an SSH command execution, including success flag, exit status, output streams, and error message.

classes.name: ISshClient
classes.description: Interface defining the contract for executing SSH commands asynchronously with given parameters.

classes.name: JSchSshClient
classes.description: Implementation of ISshClient using the JSch library, handling SSH connections, command execution, and output capturing with safety defaults.

classes.name: FakeSshClient
classes.description: A mock implementation of ISshClient for testing purposes, returning canned or simulated responses without network activity.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a remote command over SSH asynchronously, respecting timeouts and output size limits.

methods.name: boundedRead
methods.description: Reads up to a maximum number of bytes from an InputStream, used to capture stdout/stderr without unbounded memory usage.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a byte array into a String using the specified Charset, with fallback to UTF-8.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Creates an SshResult representing a failure with a given message.

methods.name: safeMessage
methods.description: Extracts a concise, non-sensitive message from an exception.
